They run in the order given, after the standard clean-up applied to every link, and after the parent domain’s rules when `inherit_parent_rules` is set. A rule that does not match the address leaves it alone.

default_language.description: The language links on this host are in. Used for links that do not say. Leave empty to inherit the parent domain’s language.

default_type.description: What kind of site this is. Used for links on this host that do not say what they are. Leave empty to inherit the parent domain’s type.

description.description: Notes about this domain for moderators. Not shown to readers.

favicon_override_url.description: Icon to show for this site instead of the one found on the host itself. Leave empty to use the host’s own.

in_metrics_allowlist.description: Include this domain in link metrics reporting.

inherit_parent_rules.description: Also apply the parent domain’s link clean-up rules, before this domain’s own. No effect when there is no parent.

name_ascii.description: The hostname, lowercase (international domains in their punycode form). Set when the domain is created and **cannot be changed afterwards** — links are matched to a domain by hostname, so renaming one would orphan every link on it. An edit that changes it is rejected.

name_display.description: The site’s name as shown to readers. International hostnames are shown in their normal script.

parent_id.description: The domain this one sits under and inherits its defaults and link clean-up rules from. Nesting is one level deep, so the parent cannot itself have a parent. Leave empty for a top-level domain.

status.description: Where the domain stands. `new` is a newly discovered host nobody has reviewed yet, `active` is in normal use. `blocked` and `archived` are both treated as untrusted whatever the trust level says, so links on them are removed when a series description is cleaned up.

trust_level.description: How much links on this host are trusted. Only `trusted` and `official` links are kept when a series description is cleaned up; the rest are removed. A `blocked` or `archived` status overrides this. Leave empty to inherit the parent domain’s level, which falls back to `neutral`.

publisher-merge.description: Fold this publisher into `merge_into_publisher_id`. Its links, series, aliases and imprints move to that publisher and its page redirects there.

merge_into_publisher_id.description: The publisher that survives. The submitted publisher redirects to it afterwards.

publisher-merge-snapshot.description: Empty publisher-merge state. Select the publisher to merge into before saving.

merge_into_publisher_id.description: The publisher that survives. The submitted publisher redirects to it afterwards.

publishers.description: Publisher record (scalars, imprint parent, and aliases).

remove_fragment.description: Drops browser-only anchor fragments. Example: /title#comments becomes /title.

replace_host.description: Renames matching hosts. Example: x.com/user becomes twitter.com/user.

series.description: Full series record (scalars, titles, tags, relationships, links, cover images).

anidb_id.description: External AniDB id; null if unmapped.

anilist_id.description: External AniList id; null if unmapped.

anime_news_network_id.description: External Anime News Network id; null if unmapped.

anime_planet_id.description: External Anime-Planet slug/id; null if unmapped.

content_rating.description: Moderator override for the series content rating; null inherits the source-derived value.

description.description: Moderator override for the series description (max 50,000 chars).

disable_automatic_external_identifiers.description: When true, stop automatic linking of external source ids to this series.

disable_automatic_publisher_assignment.description: When true, stop source-derived publisher changes for this series.

disable_automatic_tag_assignment.description: When true, stop automatic (source-derived) tag assignment for this series.

final_volume.description: Override for the final volume number (max 2 decimal places).

final_volume_override_mode.description: How `final_volume` resolves against sources: auto (manual-or-source), lock (manual verbatim), floor (manual unless a source is greater).

has_anime.description: Override marking whether the series has an anime adaptation.

images.description: Cover images for the series. **Omit this field entirely to leave the existing covers alone** — sending it, even as an empty list, replaces them, so an empty list removes every cover.

content_rating.description: Content rating of the cover image.

id.description: Existing series_images row id; null/omit for a new cover.

index.description: Display order key (string); paired with index_numeric for sorting.

index_numeric.description: Numeric sort order (derived from `index` when omitted).

is_default.description: Whether this is the default/primary cover. Exactly one cover must be default when the set is non-empty.

note.description: Free-form moderator note about this cover; send `null` when there is none. The key is required.

type.description: Cover type (volume, poster, …); defaults to `volume`.

url.description: Cover image URL. imgur is rejected (aggressive rate limiting). Acts as the cover identity on save.

work_id.description: Owning work id (uuid) when the cover belongs to a specific work; send `null` when it does not. The key is required — an omission is a 400, not "leave it alone".

is_licensed.description: Override marking whether the series is officially licensed.

is_standalone.description: Whether the series can be active on the site WITHOUT any external metadata source id (anilist_id, manga_updates_id, etc.). When true it is self-sourced - the submitter supplies the otherwise-derived fields directly (see the sourceless-required rule); when false it derives its metadata from at least one linked source.

kitsu_id.description: External Kitsu id; null if unmapped.

links.description: External link bindings (v2). Full-replace collection. Distinct from the deprecated legacy `overrides.links` URL list.

manga_updates_id.description: External MangaUpdates id (7 alphanumeric base-36 chars); null if unmapped.

media_type.description: Override for the media type (manga, manhwa, manhua, novel, …).

my_anime_list_id.description: External MyAnimeList id; null if unmapped.

original_language.description: Override for the language the series was first published in (BCP 47, e.g. `ja`).

published_end_date.description: Last publication date (YYYY-MM-DD); null if ongoing or unknown.

published_start_date.description: First publication date (YYYY-MM-DD); null if unknown.

relationships.description: Series-to-series relationships: manual rows plus merged auto-derived rows. Full-replace collection; use `_action` to remove/restore and `is_manual` to override the materializer.

series_publishers.description: Publishers of this series, one row per publisher per release language, keyed on the row `id`. Full-replace collection: a row left out is removed, as a hidden row when a source provides it. Adding or editing a row locks it.

_key.description: Client-only stable row key for new (id-less) rows; ignored server-side.

id.description: Existing series publisher row id (uuid). Omit/null to add a new row.

is_hidden.description: Hidden rows are removed publishers a source still provides. Always locked.

is_locked.description: Automation never changes a locked row. Rows added or edited by hand must be locked; only a row a source provides can be unlocked.

language.description: Language of this publisher's release of the series. `null` is the original-language release. A series lists a publisher once per language.

note.description: What this publisher published for the series, e.g. `Vol 1-3`.

series_titles.description: Series titles (v2) - the primary titles model. Full-replace collection: send the complete set and mark a removal with `is_excluded`. Supersedes the deprecated top-level `titles`.

shikimori_id.description: External Shikimori id; null if unmapped.

status.description: Override for the publication status (releasing, completed, hiatus, cancelled, …).

tags.description: The tags to apply to this series, and how relevant each one is to it.

total_chapters.description: Override for the total chapter count (max 2 decimal places).

total_chapters_override_mode.description: How `total_chapters` resolves against sources: auto (manual-or-source), lock (manual verbatim), floor (manual unless a source is greater).

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata entity id (Q-number, e.g. `Q12345`); null if unmapped.

images.description: The complete set of cover images for the series. This replaces what is already there, so include the covers you want to keep as well as the ones you are adding.

content_rating.description: Content rating of the cover image.

id.description: Existing series_images row id; null/omit for a new cover.

index.description: Display order key (string); paired with index_numeric for sorting.

index_numeric.description: Numeric sort order (derived from `index` when omitted).

is_default.description: Whether this is the default/primary cover. Exactly one cover must be default when the set is non-empty.

note.description: Free-form moderator note about this cover; send `null` when there is none. The key is required.

type.description: Cover type (volume, poster, …); defaults to `volume`.

url.description: Cover image URL. imgur is rejected (aggressive rate limiting). Acts as the cover identity on save.

work_id.description: Owning work id (uuid) when the cover belongs to a specific work; send `null` when it does not. The key is required — an omission is a 400, not "leave it alone".

series-merge.description: Request that this series be merged with another as duplicates. The merge direction is not proposed — it is derived from the pair (the lower/older id wins); the rationale rides on the submission `user_note`.

merge_with_series_id.description: The other series this one is a duplicate of. Which of the two survives the merge is decided for you, so it does not matter which side you file from — explain your reasoning in the submission note.

series-merge-snapshot.description: Empty merge-request state. Select a positive counterpart ID before saving.

merge_with_series_id.description: The other series this one is a duplicate of. Which of the two survives the merge is decided for you, so it does not matter which side you file from — explain your reasoning in the submission note.

strip_path_segment.description: Regex-replaces part of the URL path. Example: /-/en/book becomes /book.

strip_query_param.description: Removes named query parameters while keeping the rest of the URL unchanged. Example: ?utm_source=x&ref=y becomes no tracking params.

strip_subdomain.description: Removes a fixed subdomain prefix from the host. Example: www.example.com becomes example.com.

strip_trailing_slash.description: Removes a final slash from non-root paths. Example: /title/ becomes /title.

tags.description: Tag record (scalars, parent, and implication rules).

content_rating.description: The tag’s own rating. A series carries its own rating separately; it is not worked out from its tags.

description.description: What the tag means and when it applies. Shown to readers.

is_genre.description: Whether this is a genre rather than an ordinary tag. Filter `tags_v2` on this to get a series’ genres.

is_organizational.description: A tag that exists to group other tags rather than to describe a series. These are left out when matching similar series.

is_spoiler.description: Whether the tag gives away plot. Spoiler tags are blurred until you hover them. A series can override this for its own listing.

name.description: The tag’s own name, without the tags it sits under. `name_path` gives the full path.

parent_id.description: The tag this one sits under. Empty for a top-level tag.

recommendation_weight.description: How much this tag counts when matching similar series. 1 is normal, higher counts for more, and 0 leaves the tag out of matching altogether.

rules.description: Links between this tag and others that apply one automatically when the other is used. Each entry says which way round it goes — this tag implying the other, or the other implying this one.

info.description:
# About the API

All API requests are served from `https://api.mangabaka.org`

Please see the [dedicated API page for general information about the API](/api).

## Response shape

- All API endpoints, whether the request is successful or not, returns a JSON document.
- All JSON documents has a `status: number` root key, designating the status of the response.
  - The `status` field follow the HTTP response code format.
- Error response always have a `message: string` key
  - The `message` field can be safely shown to end-users, as it generally does not contain technical terminology
  - The error response may return additional root keys, please see individual endpoint for more information.
- Results that can be paginated always has a `pagination: object` root key
- Successful requests always contain a `data: object|array` root key
  - `data` is an `array` when the response is listing multiple resources
  - `data` is an `object` when the response is for a single resource
